name: SkillDB Catalog
tagline: Find reusable agent skills with public previews and source links
description: Search SkillDB's public catalog for reusable AI agent guidance, compare relevant results, and read short previews with source links. The anonymous remote server exposes two read-only tools: skilldb_search and skilldb_get_preview. No SkillDB account or API key is required. Previews are short excerpts, not complete instructions. This connection does not install or execute skills, unlock full content, or access private/team libraries. The linked public repository contains discovery adapters and branding; it does not contain the hosted service or catalog bodies.

install.notes: No credentials or environment variables are needed. Confirm that skilldb_search and skilldb_get_preview appear, then ask for skills for a task. Send only non-sensitive task keywords; HTTP request metadata, including IP addresses, is retained for 30 days. See https://skilldb.dev/privacy and https://skilldb.dev/support. Host permission controls apply. The public adapters and included logo are MIT-licensed; remotely served catalog content has separate rights.
